name: @airlox/core
description: Airlox protocol core compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: cargo build -p airlox-core-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/airlox_core_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg/web --target web && wasm-bindgen ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/airlox_core_wasm.wasm --out-dir pkg/node --target nodejs
